summary: Comprehensive testing of Labs & Imaging feature completed. All backend APIs (14/14) and frontend UI elements working correctly. Feature includes messenger-style teal chat bubbles, file upload/preview/delete functionality, proper tag filtering (lab, x-ray, ultrasound, ecg), and data isolation between users.

integration_issues.issue: Console error 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_INVALID_URL' when loading Attachments tab - thumbnails may not be loading for images stored in DB

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - accessibility concern

passed_tests: Labs & Imaging tab appears with correct count on patient profile
Upload file in Labs & Imaging works (file input + tag selector + notes + send button)
Uploaded files display as messenger-style chat bubbles (teal bubbles aligned right)
Clicking on an image file opens preview modal with image displayed
Download button visible in preview modal
Delete button on file bubbles works with confirmation
Tag selector works for Lab Result, X-Ray, Ultrasound, ECG
Attachments tab shows all attachments including lab/imaging ones
Data isolation: files uploaded by one user not visible to another user (backend test verified)
Backend: All attachment CRUD operations work correctly
Backend: Tag filtering works for lab/x-ray/ultrasound/ecg
Backend: User authentication and authorization working
Backend: Patient ownership verification enforced on all endpoints
action_items: MINOR: Add aria-describedby to DialogContent components for better accessibility
MINOR: Review Attachments tab thumbnail loading - possible base64 URL format issue
critical_code_review_comments: Code follows data isolation pattern correctly - all endpoints verify owner_id
File upload uses multipart/form-data correctly with Base64 encoding for DB storage
Frontend handles image vs non-image files correctly (preview modal vs download)
data-testid attributes properly added for all interactive elements
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created 7 test attachments with various tags (lab, x-ray, ultrasound, ecg). Some were deleted during UI testing.
